'''Hapoel Hadera–Giv'at Olga "Shulem Schwarz" F.C.''' ({{langx|he|מועדון כדורגל הפועל חדרה–גבעת אולגה שולם שוורץ}}) is an Israeli [[association football|football]] club from [[Hadera]] who  currently play in the [[Liga Leumit]], the second tier of [[Football in Israel|Israeli football]] following relegation from the [[Israeli Premier League]] in the [[2024–25 Israeli Premier League|2024–25 season]]."}}
